about_the_game: Dive into the vibrant world of Axe & Bow Land with its captivating soundtrack. Featuring 21 main tracks and 17 exclusive additional compositions not found in the game, this soundtrack offers a diverse blend of serene melodies and lively tunes. From tranquil compositions that evoke a sense of wonder to upbeat tracks with infectious rhythms, experience a unique mix of arcade, electric piano, and drum beats, accompanied by Aztec-inspired wind instruments. Enhance your gaming experience with the unforgettable melodies of Axe & Bow Land's original soundtrack today.
